data.body: **[P1] Invalidate cached values when serializing an entity again.** A context-aware SerDes can overwrite a deterministic external key and return the same reference string. A later in-process retry then writes new state, but `deserializeResult()` hits the old cache entry because the entity, type, and reference hash are unchanged, causing first execution to consume stale state while replay reads the new value. Add a per-SerDes/context generation to completed and in-flight keys, or atomically invalidate that context before serialization, and test repeated serialization with a stable external reference.
